filterSummary: Filtered out a total of 471 videos from 479 candidates. Main reasons: irrelevant content (e.g., Rubik's cube, Excel tricks, gaming), wrong audio language (e.g., Hindi, Tamil, or English substituted for Arabic), duration outside 60–3600s, and duplicate channels per topic. No suitable Arabic videos were found for Randomized Quicksort and Skip List topics, so they were omitted to maintain quality.
